nodes.name: Electrodeposition of Au Needles
nodes.procedure: The Au needle electrode was formed using a 160 mM HAuCl4 solution and direct current potential amperometry at -400 mV for 300 s. Concentration of HCl was fixed at 0.5 mol l-1.
nodes.source_text: The Au needle electrode was formed using a 160 mM HAuCl4 solution and direct current potential amperometry at -400 mV for 300 s.

nodes.name: Electrodeposition of Au Rods
nodes.procedure: Au rod electrodes were formed using direct current potential amperometry at -250 mV with 26 mM HAuCl4 solutions for 900 s. Concentration of HCl was fixed at 0.5 mol l-1.
nodes.source_text: Au particle, rod and leaf electrodes were formed using direct current potential amperometry at -250 mV with 13 mM , 26 mM and 40 mM HAuCl solutions for 1,200 s, 900 s and 600 s, respectively.

nodes.name: Electrodeposition of Au Particles
nodes.procedure: Au particle electrodes were formed using direct current potential amperometry at -250 mV with 13 mM HAuCl4 solutions for 1,200 s. Concentration of HCl was fixed at 0.5 mol l-1.
nodes.source_text: Au particle, rod and leaf electrodes were formed using direct current potential amperometry at -250 mV with 13 mM , 26 mM and 40 mM HAuCl solutions for 1,200 s, 900 s and 600 s, respectively.

nodes.name: Electrodeposition of Pd Needles
nodes.procedure: Pd needles were synthesized by a two-step potential square wave electrodeposition in a solution of 2 mM K2PdCl6 in 0.5 M H2SO4. In the first step, E1, T1, E2 and T2 were 0.8 V, 0.05 s, -0.7 V and 0.02 s, respectively (1,200 waves). For the second step E1, T1, E2 and T2 were 0.6 V, 0.005 s, 0.25 V and 0.005 s, respectively (100,000 waves).

unit_operations.name: First Step Electrodeposition
unit_operations.procedure_snippet: In the first step, E1, T1, E2 and T2 were 0.8 V, 0.05 s, -0.7 V and 0.02 s, respectively. The number of square waves was 1,200.

unit_operations.name: Second Step Electrodeposition
unit_operations.procedure_snippet: For the second step E1, T1, E2 and T2 were 0.6 V, 0.005 s, 0.25 V and 0.005 s, respectively. The number of square waves was 100,000.

nodes.name: Electrodeposition of Au Leaves
nodes.procedure: Au leaf electrodes were formed using direct current potential amperometry at -250 mV with 40 mM HAuCl4 solutions for 600 s. Concentration of HCl was fixed at 0.5 mol l-1.

nodes.name: Preparation of Pd rods
nodes.procedure: Pd rods were synthesized by a two-step potential square wave electrodeposition. In the first step, E1, T1, E2 and T2 were 0.8 V, 0.05 s, -0.7 V and 0.02 s (1,200 waves). For the second step E1 was set at 0.2 V with the number of square waves being 50,000.
nodes.source_text: For the preparation of Pd rods, E1 was set at 0.2 V with the number of square waves being 50,000 in the second step. All other parameters remained the same as for the Pd needles.

nodes.name: Preparation of Pd particles
nodes.procedure: Pd particles were synthesized by applying only the first step for Pd needle deposition and the square wave number was set to 50,000. E1, T1, E2 and T2 were 0.8 V, 0.05 s, -0.7 V and 0.02 s.
nodes.source_text: For preparation of Pd particles, only the first step for Pd needle deposition was applied and the square wave number was set to 50,000.
